To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Norwegian PV market is characterized by: (1) a very high growth rate; (2) a high degree of domestication of the technology, which is manifested in a high degree of integration with the roof; (3) a high degree in terms of the number of prosumers; (4) an absence of policy and support systems, and (5) a very high degree of prosumers’ satisfaction with their PV systems.
